description: Search the Roraima catalog of products for sale, such as smart devices, smart locks and installation services, by words in their name or description. Holiday rentals are not included: they come from search_listings.

country.description: Delivery country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) the prices refer to. Optional: without it, each price comes with the country it applies to.

language.description: Language of names, descriptions and page links. Default en.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "smart plug" or "Shelly". Without it, the newest products.

name: search_products
title: Search products
